# Can one cell grow into a whole plant?

<!-- STEP id="together" -->
## Working together
In your arm, nervous tissue sends the signal, a muscle contracts, a tendon passes the pull and a bone moves at a joint. Each of these parts is made of cells that are specialised for one job.

<!-- STEP id="plant" -->
## A plant cell that grows into a plant
Plants can do something surprising. In the right conditions, a single plant cell or a small piece of plant tissue can divide again and again and grow into a whole new plant. How can a cell that already had one job give rise to every tissue of a plant? We will see this in the next lesson.
